rationale: Dated, name-level supervisor authorisations for bank/savings-bank board and supervisory-board appointments — the primary A5 leadership-move feed for Slovenia.
Canonical actor list of supervised banks, payment and e-money institutions; the join key for leadership-move events and entity-status changes.
Statutory payments-side registers (PI/EMI, agents, branches) — payments actors carry equal weight; verification failure is a soft signal only.
Regulator's own vacancy channel — direct evidence of supervisory capacity build-up and unit-level reorganisation.
Low-noise machine-friendly endpoint rendering the live BS vacancy list; ideal polled complement to the careers pages.
Careers hub on bsi.si whose vacancy and scholarship children are already captured by c_004/c_005; monitor as part of the BS domain.
Narrative announcements of BS governance and leadership changes with effective dates; continuous publication stream.
FOI catalogue carrying organigram and responsible officials — cheap diffable baseline for internal reorganisation detection.
ATVP vacancy page naming organisational units; standalone hiring feed for the securities supervisor, fetch failure is soft only.
Org-chart page naming sectors and heads; diffing it detects both ATVP leadership moves and restructuring.
Investment-firm authorisation register tightly coupled to ATVP board-member fit-and-proper approvals; recurring dated changes.
Live, dated AZN vacancy listings with named sectors — high-signal supervisory capacity and reorganisation feed.
Static procedure/guidance section of a-zn.si already covered by monitoring the agency site; useful reference, not an event stream.
Central filterable public-sector vacancy register covering MF, UJP, FURS and agencies including director competitions; best structured A5 feed.
Single posting for the AZN director role — worked example evidencing the collection pattern; the parent register (c_014) is the monitored source.
UJP institutional page is a gov.si sub-page; leadership and unit data useful but its vacancies flow through the central register.
Legally definitive, dated and archived record of senior appointments plus the electronic Razglasni del of public competitions.
One-off presidential nomination announcement; valuable earliest-signal evidence, but the domain's publication cadence is episodic.
Permit catalogue to mine once for the actor/permit/authority map (BS vs ATVP vs AZN), then archive.
Person-level register/eObjave corroborating board and representative changes, but access_status unknown — ePRS person search needs access cleared first.
Fit-and-proper decisions for Slovenian significant institutions are ECB decisions; omitting it blinds the largest banks.
Statutory basis (ZBan-3, ZZavar-1, ZPlaSSIED) to mine once for which appointments must be published and by whom.
Aggregators duplicate primary vacancy pages with rewritten titles and low credibility; only value is latency/archive redundancy.
Canonical URL is a single RTV article; media tripwire value is real but should be captured as a query/feed, not this page.
Largest Slovenian bank's newsroom publishing named board appointments, departures and reorganisations with effective dates.
Regulated inside-information disclosures where NLB board changes appear first and most precisely.
Stable issuer-side index of NLB SEOnet filings including board-change notifications; distinct domain from the group site.
